cohort.selection: Exact frozen R04/DQ17-v2 development IDs; no new split or filtering

initialization: Fresh fixed-seed weights, matching original R04 initialization; no trained checkpoint warm start
selection: Earliest strictly lowest validation MAE among epochs 1 onward; stop after 15 consecutive epochs without improvement; epoch zero excluded
inputs: EPSS Days 0-30 with missingness and observation-age channels; cached description graph for no_coref
references: matched frozen R04 full Smooth L1 fits
limitations: Development validation has informed prior choices; it is not an independent final test
Partial input histories remain eligible; no fabricated target scores or future input filling
Current descriptions remain retrospective rather than authenticated historical Day-30 inputs
Selecting MAE does not establish a model improvement over persistence or useful TPG contribution
All seeds and both models are reported; no best-seed selection
After review, freeze the final evaluation protocol before a separate held-out test stage
